original_ai_output.title_zh: 教育部长欢迎军事医学院列入JAMB 2026/2027学年招生门户
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚教育部长Tunji Alausa对武装部队医学与健康科学学院（AFCOM-HS）被列入JAMB 2026/2027学年招生门户表示欢迎。该学院位于拉各斯亚巴的尼日利亚陆军第68参考医院内，计划招收首批100名学员，开设医学与外科学（MBBS）及护理学（B.NSc.）学位课程。部长称此举有助于加强军队医疗服务和国家卫生安全。相关信息来自单一来源报道。

location.site: 亚巴尼日利亚陆军第68参考医院
location.raw_text: 68 Nigerian Army Reference Hospital, Yaba, Lagos

key_facts.fact: 教育部长Alausa欢迎AFCOM-HS列入JAMB 2026/2027学年招生门户
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Minister of Education, Dr Tunji Alausa, has welcomed the listing of the Armed Forces College of Medicine and Health Sciences (AFCOM-HS) on the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) portal for the 2026/2027 academic session.

key_facts.fact: 该学院位于拉各斯亚巴的尼日利亚陆军第68参考医院内
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the institution, located within the 68 Nigerian Army Reference Hospital, Yaba, Lagos

key_facts.fact: 学院计划招收首批100名学员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: was preparing to admit its pioneer cohort of 100 cadets

key_facts.fact: 学院已获NUC批准开设MBBS和护理学学士课程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the college had secured approval from the National Universities Commission (NUC) to offer Medicine and Surgery, leading to the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) degree, and Nursing Science, leading to the Bachelor of Nursing Science (B.NSc.) degree.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
招生具体资格标准、申请程序及录取日期尚未公布，需以官方渠道为准
